family_reports.body: This system has isolated, an alienated, a daughter and a mother from having a relationship when I could’ve died from cancer, they allowed a father to kidnap a child from her home state and for me and her brother and sister and take her to another state to be held like a prisoner while they made profits off of my daughter, put her on medication and kept her away from me for four years I still haven’t talked to her or seen her since September 9 of 2024. I got one visit after the custody order was issued because he’s on drugs. He refuses to let me see my child and I filed the contempt in the state of Iowa, and they still keep denying my contempt and are not allowing me to see my child. This is ruined my family, my life they’ve harassed me they’ve hacked into my phones. They drove me out of the state of Iowa and now I live in a different state because I could no longer live there anymore after all of this psychological warfare.
